current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要技术将动态时序图映射为固定规模的新图，解决了GNN输出无法直接输入RNN训练的问题，并利用图自编码器与循环神经网络学习时序特征。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which maps dynamic sequential graphs to fixed-size new graphs via graph summarization, solving the problem that GNN outputs cannot be directly fed into RNN, and uses graph autoencoder and recurrent neural network to learn temporal features.
source_locations: abstract: GSAERU模型由“图表征学习模块”和“时序学习模块”两部分构成...
作者贡献段1: 提出了一种新的图表示学习模型——GSAERU...通过引入图摘要技术将原图映射到固定规模的新图，解决了GNN模型输出无法直接输入到RNN模型中进行训练的问题
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
在单时间步上，通过图摘要技术压缩原图，将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点表征
将单时间步图表征输入循环神经网络，学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each time step

At each time step, compress the original graph via graph summarization, feed the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder, and train node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Feed the per-time-step graph representations into a recurrent neural network to learn temporal features and dependencies

strategies.description: graph summarization AND temporal graph representation learning AND graph autoencoder AND recurrent neural network
